FieldError.description:
One field-level failure inside a problem response.

Present so that a rejected submission can be rendered against the form that produced
it — FR-403 requires deterministic failures to name the offending field rather
than only the operation.

code.description: Stable machine code for this field.
code.title: Code

field.description: Dotted path to the offending field, e.g. 'spec.family'.
field.title: Field

FieldError.title: FieldError

description:
An RFC 9457 problem response.

`code` is the contract, not `title` or `status`: titles are prose and several
conditions share a status, so a client that branches on anything else is branching on
something the platform is free to reword.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, namespaced per module and enumerated in that module's spec. This is what clients branch on.
code.title: Code

errors.description: Field-level errors, where the failure is field-attributable.
errors.title: Errors

title.description: Short human-readable summary, stable per type.
title.title: Title

trace_id.description: OpenTelemetry trace id for this request. Appears in every log line for the request, so a support conversation starts with an identifier (FR-445).
trace_id.title: Trace Id

type.description: URI identifying the problem type; documentation lives at that URI.
type.title: Type
